13.3. Micro Application Generator (rtiddsmag)¶

13.3.1. Apache Commons CLI¶

  • Used in Micro Application Generator.

  • Version 1.4

  • Open Source Software License: Apache License Version 2.0 (full text found in Licenses).

13.3.2. Apache Commons Lang 3¶

  • Used in Micro Application Generator. We only use the class StringUtils.

  • Version 3.7

  • Open Source Software License: Apache License Version 2.0 (full text found in Licenses).

13.3.3. Apache Log4j 2¶

  • Version: 2.25.3

  • Open Source Software License: Apache License Version 2.0 (full text found in Licenses).
